title: The Code AI Maturity Model and What It Means For You: Ado Kukic
talk_summary: Ado Kukic presents Sourcegraph's six-level 'Code AI maturity model' (levels 0-5 across human-initiated, AI-initiated, and AI-led categories), mapping each level to SAE self-driving autonomy levels. It is a conceptual/educational framework with no implementation details, benchmarks, or engineering mechanisms.

takeaways.technique: Autonomy-level vocabulary for agent task scoping
takeaways.what_they_do: Defines levels where L3 = AI builds a full component from high-level requirements with human as fallback, L4 = AI proactively submits PRs (docs updates, bug fixes) that humans only review/merge, L5 = AI owns concept-to-production with humans validating outcomes not code.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the coding assistant could monitor bug reports from customers and submit PRS to fix the issues the human developer could then simply review the pull requests and merge them
